title: 24 Hours Exotic Car Rally Experience - Miami-Key West-Miami, FL
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A 24-hour Supercar Rally Experience from Miami to Key West, FL and back on four exotic cars is a thrilling adventure that takes you through some of the most beautiful scenery in South Florida. The rally departure is at 1:00 pm and the return time is the following day at 1:00 pm. With dinner and an overnight stay in a 5-star hotel in Key West included in the rally price. This road trip is the perfect way to explore the Florida Keys in style. Here are four cars you will drive that would be perfect for this epic road trip: Lamborghini Huracan EVO, Ferrari 488 Spider, Mclaren 570S Spider and Mercedes Benz AMG GT(Depending on availability)
Starting in Miami, you’ll drive down the Overseas Highway, which spans over 200 miles of breathtaking scenery. The route takes you across numerous islands and bridges, including the iconic Seven Mile Bridge. You will have the chance along the way to switch cars with other drivers so you can enjoy and experience every exotic car in the rally.
